Here is what changed, how to use it, and where a chatbot voice ends and a real voice layer begins.

items.summary: On July 23, 2026, OpenAI brought ChatGPT Voice to its Mac and Windows desktop app. Powered by GPT-Live, it lets you talk to your computer to control it and steer multiple agents across ChatGPT Work and Codex. items.title: Voice Is the Final Interface: The World of 'Her' Is Becoming Real
items.summary: In Spike Jonze's Her, everyone walks through the city talking quietly to an AI, each in their own bubble, and no one thinks it strange. As artificial intelligence grows capable enough to do the actual work, that calm, screen-free, voice-first world stops being science fiction. Here is why voice is the final interface, what the movie's world gets right, and how VoiceOS is building toward it.

items.title: The AI That Helps You With Whatever's on Your Screen (2026)
items.summary: We have all been stuck: a menu we cannot find, a setting buried three panels deep, an app we have never used before. A new kind of assistant changes that.
